pastoralcraft.configuration.title: PastoralCraft Configs
pastoralcraft.configuration.defaultDaysP: Default number of solar days required for each crop growth stage. Lower values = faster growth.
pastoralcraft.configuration.daysPerFruit: Solar days between each fruiting attempt of a mature stem. A fruit is placed when the days since planting is a positive multiple of this value.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stemFruitDir: Comma-separated horizontal directions a mature stem may fruit toward, in deterministic check order. Valid: north, south, east, west. Default: east,north.
pastoralcraft.configuration.unsuitableMu: Chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an arable crop mutates to short grass on each growth attempt in an unsuitable season.
pastoralcraft.configuration.unsuitableGr: Chance (0.0 - 1.0) that an arable crop advances one stage on each growth attempt in an unsuitable season.
pastoralcraft.configuration.stemUnsuitab: Chance (0.0 - 1.0) that a mature stem mutates to short grass on each fruiting cycle in an unsuitable season.
Chance (0.0 - 1.0) that a mature stem produces a fruit on each fruiting cycle in an unsuitable season. Mutate, fruit, and idle form a three-way roll.
pastoralcraft.configuration.catchUpSeaso: Assumed number of solar days per Solar Term, used to estimate elapsed suitable days during chunk-load catch-up. Must match Ecliptic Seasons' LastingDaysOfEachTerm.
pastoralcraft.configuration.catchUpTimeB: Per-invocation time budget (milliseconds) for a single chunk-load or periodic catch-up pass. When exceeded, remaining entries are deferred to the next periodic cycle instead of blocking the server thread. Set to 0 to disable.
pastoralcraft.configuration.maxCatchUpEl: Upper bound (solar days) on the elapsed time a single catch-up simulation may span. Prevents the per-crop simulation from looping unboundedly after a large Ecliptic Seasons day jump. Default 336 = 2 ES years (1 year = 168 days).
pastoralcraft.configuration.defaultUntag: Default suitable seasons for crops with no seasons override and no Ecliptic Seasons tags. Comma-separated spring/summer/autumn/winter, or 'year_round'. Default: spring,autumn.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugLogging: Enable debug logging for crop growth decisions in the game log.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugFlaxAll: Log every supplementaries:flax state change to debug.log (requires debugLogging).
Log crop/height-crop growth, harvest, bonemeal, and entry add/remove. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugStem.to: Log stem fruiting, mutation, bonemeal, and harvest. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugSideEff: Log maturity side effects (transform/companion/bonemeal fallback/double upper half). Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugCatchUp: Log chunk-load/periodic catch-up summaries and NBT save/load counts. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugData.to: Scan plantedDay anomalies (negative/over-horizon) on catch-up entry. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugPerf.to: Enable timed sections and a setBlock counter to locate slow paths. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugRing.to: Record events into an in-memory ring buffer for crash/freeze backtrace. Requires debugLogging.
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugPerfWar: Profiled sections exceeding this many milliseconds warn (range 1-60000).
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugRingSiz: Number of events the debug ring buffer holds (range 256-65536).
pastoralcraft.configuration.debugDumpOnS: Write the ring buffer/profiler/data-health to the logs/ directory when the server stops.
pastoralcraft.configuration.cropOverride: Override growth settings for specific crops. Format: "modid:crop_id=daysPerStage=N,seasons=S1,S2,topBlock=...,transformBlock=...,water=true,doubleAge=N,freeze=true,climbBlock=...,climbSupport=...,maxClimbHeight=N"
